auditMetadata.title: Shared Drive Provisioning Preparation & Setup Specification

MANUAL_ADMIN_STEPS: 1. Google Workspace Administrator logs into https://drive.google.com using corporate account.
2. Create a new Shared Drive named 'Q-Saudi'.
3. Add Project Administrators / App OAuth User Accounts as Members with 'Content Manager' or 'Contributor' role.
4. Inside 'Q-Saudi' Shared Drive, create a top-level parent folder named 'Projects'.
5. Extract the Shared Drive ID from the URL (e.g., https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/<SHARED_DRIVE_ID>).
6. Extract the 'Projects' Root Folder ID from its URL (e.g., https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/<GOOGLE_PROJECTS_ROOT_FOLDER_ID>).
7. Add GOOGLE_SHARED_DRIVE_ID and GOOGLE_PROJECTS_ROOT_FOLDER_ID to Cloud Run / Vercel Server Environment Variables.

workspaceResourceSpecification.justification: Creating the Shared Drive manually via the Google Workspace Admin console guarantees corporate ownership, eliminates programmatic domain-permission errors, and avoids needing super-admin OAuth privileges within the web application.

serverSideVariables.name: GOOGLE_SHARED_DRIVE_ID
serverSideVariables.description: Unique Google Drive ID of the corporate Shared Drive container ('Q-Saudi').

serverSideVariables.name: GOOGLE_PROJECTS_ROOT_FOLDER_ID
serverSideVariables.description: Folder ID of the 'Projects' directory inside the 'Q-Saudi' Shared Drive.

clientSideVariables.name: VITE_FIREBASE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
clientSideVariables.description: Firebase OAuth Client ID used by GoogleAuthProvider.

changes: Inject query parameter supportsAllDrives: true into drive.files.create for Project Root Folder creation.
Inject supportsAllDrives: true into drive.files.create calls for subfolder creations ('imported files', 'reports', 'printable documents').
Inject supportsAllDrives: true into drive.files.update when moving the Master Google Sheet into the project folder.
Ensure sheets API requests specify spreadsheetId and propagate authentication token with supportsAllDrives where applicable.
Pass authorization token and project metadata to backend endpoint /api/workspace/provision.
Handle updated lifecycle states: PENDING_PROVISIONING, READY, PARTIAL, RETRY_REQUIRED.
Decouple Firestore project document creation (State: PENDING_PROVISIONING) from Google Drive API execution.
Update status to READY upon successful folder and sheet initialization, or PARTIAL/RETRY_REQUIRED upon error.

permissionsAndRoleMapping.companyWorkspaceAdmin: Full administrative control over Google Workspace and Shared Drive membership.
permissionsAndRoleMapping.superAdmin: App-level full management, initiates workspace provisioning, assigned 'Content Manager' or 'Manager' in Shared Drive.
permissionsAndRoleMapping.projectAdmin: App-level management for assigned projects, assigned 'Contributor' or 'Content Manager' in Shared Drive.
permissionsAndRoleMapping.supervisor: Operational field supervisor, interactions mediated through app API (no direct Drive access required).
permissionsAndRoleMapping.operationalUsers: Drivers and weighbridge operators, restricted strictly to app UI.

order: 2. Project Root Folder created in Shared Drive (State: IN_PROGRESS)
3. Three subfolders created in Project Root Folder ('imported files', 'reports', 'printable documents')
4. Master Google Sheet created and moved into Project Root Folder
5. Sheet tabs initialized with Saudi Arabic headers (Operations, Drivers, Carriers, Materials, Exceptions, Reports)
6. Firestore Project Document updated with googleDriveFolderId and googleSpreadsheetId (State: READY)

migrationAndRollbackStrategy.migrationStrategy: Scripted server-side relocation calling drive.files.update with supportsAllDrives=true and addParents=GOOGLE_PROJECTS_ROOT_FOLDER_ID for existing My Drive project folders.
migrationAndRollbackStrategy.rollbackStrategy: If Google Shared Drive API call fails during project setup, the Firestore project remains intact in PENDING_PROVISIONING or RETRY_REQUIRED state. The user can trigger an explicit retry via UI without creating duplicate Firestore documents.
